provenance: Literal rectangular source samples normalized to 72px tiles; baked source lighting retained. Characters use semantic visible-fragment alpha masks. No hidden sprite content is inferred.
layout: Source-sized 1536x1024 composition, generated 12x8 board at [350,210], dry floor palette, single contiguous side water channel, source exit architecture and torches, connected entrance/exit with isolated pillars and separated source-visible actors.
ui: Exact source raster UI components at source placement, fixed source text and values. No font replacement or variable value claim.

constraints.connectivity: BFS verifies all dry walkable cells and entrance-to-exit connection; reject candidate walls that disconnect them.
constraints.uiValues: Fixed to source raster values; arbitrary stat editing requires explicit text replacement.
